comment: 装备蓝本(11 家族 × 4 件 = 44 件):3 件打造档 + 1 件掉落专属。rarities 品质倍率与词缀条数,affixes 词缀池,sets 套装 2/4/6 件加成。effects 在强化 0、品质普通时为基准,品质倍率与每级 +50% 强化在 HomesteadBonus 里乘算。

slots.name: 草帽
slots.desc: 晒场上挡太阳的宽檐草帽。
slots.desc_en: A wide straw hat for sunny days.

slots.name: 药农斗笠
slots.desc: 竹篾编的斗笠,山里人认药的眼力戴在头上。
slots.desc_en: A bamboo hat worn by herb hunters.

slots.name: 绣花头巾
slots.desc: 一针一线绣了满月的头巾,戴上心里静。
slots.desc_en: A hood embroidered over many nights.

slots.name: 粗布围裙
slots.desc: 靛蓝粗布围裙,溅上油星也不心疼。
slots.desc_en: A sturdy indigo apron.

slots.name: 皮围裙
slots.desc: 压酪时穿的厚皮围裙,奶渍一擦就掉。
slots.desc_en: A thick leather apron for cheese work.

slots.name: 云锦长衫
slots.desc: 云锦裁的长衫,走动时像有光在流。
slots.desc_en: A long robe cut from brocade.

slots.name: 麻布袖套
slots.desc: 护住袖口的麻布套,搬石头不磨手。
slots.desc_en: Linen sleeves that save your cuffs.

slots.name: 工匠手套
slots.desc: 指节加厚的皮手套,省料也省力。
slots.desc_en: Thick-knuckled leather gloves.

slots.name: 银丝护腕
slots.desc: 缠了银丝的护腕,抬手时叮当作响。
slots.desc_en: Bracers wound with silver thread.

slots.name: 布鞋
slots.desc: 千层底的布鞋,走一天不累。
slots.desc_en: Cloth shoes with layered soles.

slots.name: 远行靴
slots.desc: 靴筒到膝的皮靴,走远路也不灌风。
slots.desc_en: Knee-high leather boots.

slots.name: 云履
slots.desc: 鞋底软得像踩云,回来时天还没黑。
slots.desc_en: Soles as soft as clouds.

slots.name: 松果挂饰
slots.desc: 晒干的松果串,镇上看货的都说吉利。
slots.desc_en: A string of dried pinecones.

slots.name: 琥珀坠
slots.desc: 裹着旧叶的琥珀坠子,越戴越亮。
slots.desc_en: An amber pendant with an old leaf inside.

slots.name: 星屑铃
slots.desc: 星屑磨成的小铃,风一过有细响。
slots.desc_en: A tiny bell ground from a star shard.

slots.name: 鱼骨项链
slots.desc: 溪鱼骨串成的小项链，走水边不招虫。
slots.desc_en: A little necklace of stream-fish bones.

slots.name: 珍珠项圈
slots.desc: 一圈溪珠，光下泛着水色。
slots.desc_en: A collar of river pearls.

slots.name: 深海坠
slots.desc: 鲟鱼鳞与锦缎缠成的深水护符。
slots.desc_en: A deepwater pendant of sturgeon scale and brocade.

slots.name: 卵石护肩
slots.desc: 缝着圆卵石的粗布护肩，挑担不硌。
slots.desc_en: Coarse cloth pads sewn with round pebbles.

slots.name: 青石披肩
slots.desc: 青石片缀成的披肩，压得住风。
slots.desc_en: A mantle of blue stone plates.

slots.name: 玉矿护肩
slots.desc: 玉矿薄片磨圆的护肩，镇纸一样沉。
slots.desc_en: Pauldrons of polished jade ore.

slots.name: 羊毛披风
slots.desc: 旧羊毛披风，羊圈里坐得住。
slots.desc_en: An old wool cloak for long nights in the pen.

slots.name: 绒线斗篷
slots.desc: 绒线织的厚斗篷，落雪也不冷。
slots.desc_en: A thick cashmere cloak that shrugs off snow.

slots.name: 云锦大氅
slots.desc: 云锦里子的大氅，出门像过节。
slots.desc_en: A greatcloak lined with cloud brocade.

slots.name: 木珠手串
slots.desc: 松木车的小珠，抬手就闻香。
slots.desc_en: Little pine beads turned on the lathe.

slots.name: 凿工护腕
slots.desc: 硬皮护腕，凿凿子不磨手。
slots.desc_en: A hard leather bracer for long chisel work.

slots.name: 香樟护腕
slots.desc: 香樟木片包边，虫不蛀手不酸。
slots.desc_en: Camphor plates bound into a wristguard.

slots.name: 草绳腰带
slots.desc: 一截草绳，酒瓮边站着顺手系。
slots.desc_en: A length of straw rope for standing by the vats.

slots.name: 酒桶腰封
slots.desc: 旧桶箍改成腰封，稳当。
slots.desc_en: A barrel hoop turned into a wide belt.

slots.name: 参酒围腰
slots.desc: 参酒浸过的围腰，冬天也不僵。
slots.desc_en: A girdle soaked in ginseng brew.

slots.name: 酪纹戒指
slots.desc: 奶酪压纹的铜圈，图个吉利。
slots.desc_en: A copper ring stamped with a cheese mark.

slots.name: 黄油指环
slots.desc: 奶香渗进铜纹里，镇上人认得。
slots.desc_en: A ring that keeps the smell of butter.

slots.name: 奶糕印戒
slots.desc: 印在奶糕上的花纹，如今成了戒指。
slots.desc_en: The pattern pressed into cream cakes, cast as a ring.

slots.name: 潮汐护符
slots.desc: 潮水退去时捡到的护符，凑近能听见水声。
slots.desc_en: An amulet found when the tide went out.

slots.name: 采石护肩
slots.desc: 旧矿工留下的护肩，垫肩处磨得发亮。
slots.desc_en: A quarryman's shoulder guard, polished at the ridge.

slots.name: 牧人披风
slots.desc: 沾着草籽的旧披风，盖着能睡一晚。
slots.desc_en: A seed-flecked cloak that makes a warm night outdoors.

slots.name: 木纹腕带
slots.desc: 顺着木纹削出来的腕带，握凿更稳。
slots.desc_en: A wristband cut along the grain.

slots.name: 酿师腰带
slots.desc: 酒坊老师傅传下来的腰带，浸透了酒气。
slots.desc_en: A master brewer's belt, steeped in wine.

slots.name: 牧铃指环
slots.desc: 小铃铛做的指环，走一圈羊群就跟着走。
slots.desc_en: A ring of tiny bells that keeps the herd close.

slots.name: 林冠头环
slots.desc: 藤与野莓缠的头环，林子里很显眼。
slots.desc_en: A crown of vines and berries.

slots.name: 猎户背心
slots.desc: 猎户的旧背心，口袋多得数不清。
slots.desc_en: An old hunter's vest with too many pockets.

slots.name: 荆棘手套
slots.desc: 摘野果不怕刺的手套。
slots.desc_en: Gloves that laugh at thorns.

slots.name: 苔痕草鞋
slots.desc: 鞋底长过苔的草鞋，走田埂最稳。
slots.desc_en: Sandals whose soles have grown moss.

slots.name: 山灵铃
slots.desc: 进山时挂在腰上的小铃，风一动就响。
slots.desc_en: A little bell hung at the waist on the way into the woods.
